label: 5.1 cm Cuff Turn-Up
description: A 5.1cm (2-inch) turn-up cuff is the deeper, modern-standard cuff popularised by Italian tailoring, adding noticeable weight and presence at the hem. The extra depth makes a confident statement and anchors fuller, pleated and wide-leg trousers especially well. Like all cuffs it is best avoided on the most formal evening trousers.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
